newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Intiselera up despite soft sentiment.
newsitem.headline: Intiselera up despite soft sentiment.

text.p: Indonesian noodle maker PT Asia Intiselera made modest gains on its debut on Wednesday despite overall soft market sentiment, brokers said.

At 0325 GMT, Intiselera was trading at 1,000 rupiah against the offer price of 950 rupiah and topped the active list with some 24 million shares traded. It had risen to a high of 1,100 rupiah earlier.

"It's an encouraging debut amid the soft market sentiment. But Intiselera is unlikely to touch a high of 1,100 rupiah again today due to its small size and stiff competition in the instant noodle market," one broker said.
Intiselera offered 45 million shares to the public during an initial offering period in late May.
Privately-owned brokerage firm PT Trimegah Securindolestari acted as the lead underwriter for the share offering.
